body:
First (recalled) NDE, similar to descriptions in Jansen's book, was experienced with this combo. Also, first time the term OMFG was used (outloud, over and over) outside of a forum. No anxiety, just a slow, smooth transition in and out of a bright yellow-orange sea of peacefulness and bliss. Afterwords felt like cold alpine glacier melt had been used to flush out every neuron and synapse.
